title: The people behind the value
summary: From invisible code to live events, colleagues across RELX can see how their work becomes something customers feel: speed, confidence, reach and better decisions.
body_markdown:
## **Seeing the impact every day**


Brian Rouse and his Legal colleagues in the US provide human expertise that helps ensure AI solutions reflect real-world legal practice. Their line of sight comes through the products they strengthen: “The work we do is recognised and valued. We see the results of it and how it’s enriching and improving our products, and ultimately, improving those products for our customers.”


For Meera Patel, Senior Manager - Employment and Payroll Taxes, that line of sight to customer value might seem less obvious. But as with many colleagues working in Corporate teams, that’s simply not so. “My work benefits RELX employees, business leaders *and* customers. I help colleagues travel and work internationally in a compliant way, so the business can deploy expertise where it is needed. RELX creates value through the expertise, products and services delivered by its people. Customers benefit when the right colleagues can support them in the right place, at the right time.”


For Relationship Director Rebecca Greenstreet in Legal in Australia, working directly with clients makes that impact especially immediate. “By leveraging our market-leading technology and rich content sets, you are able to help our clients make real improvements and change in their business; in sales you get to see the impact of your work every day.”


In Exhibitions in the UK, RX Engineering Manager Graeme Sacks leads teams responsible for systems that support registration and ecommerce across events. “I’m not just managing a team, I’m focused on ensuring our programme is delivering the best possible outcomes for RX and our customers.”


Silke Frank, who has responsibility for the strategic development of FIBO (the world's leading trade show for health, fitness and wellness) within Exhibitions in Germany, expresses the purpose of exhibitions as being “to bring customers and markets together worldwide with and through our products, services and shows.”


And in the Philippines, Operations Manager Vic Conte makes sure colleagues understand more than the tasks they perform. Asked how she makes their work meaningful, her answer was: “By helping the team members understand the purpose and impact of their roles in serving our consumers.”
